description: This file defines the ServiceHelper class, which extends Android's Service class. It manages binding, lifecycle events, and communication with an activity for voice recognition, including starting recognition and delivering results via a callback interface.

classes.name: ServiceHelper
classes.description: A service that facilitates communication between the voice recognition activity and the IME, handling recognition start and result notification.

classes.name: ServiceHelper.Callback
classes.description: Interface for callback to deliver recognition results.

classes.name: ServiceHelper.ServiceHelperBinder
classes.description: Binder class to provide clients with access to the ServiceHelper instance.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder object for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service and logs creation.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up the service and logs destruction.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Starts voice recognition by launching the ActivityHelper activity and setting the callback.

methods.name: notifyResult
methods.description: Delivers the recognition result to the registered callback.
